visual.general_description: Composite of four skin histology panels: a large HE section above, and IgG, C3 direct immunofluorescence and PAS sections below.
visual.detailed_description: A large top panel labeled HE shows an H and E stained skin section with a thick keratin layer at the top marked by a hash symbol, an asterisk in the epidermis, two arrowheads at the lower epidermis and two arrows at the dermo-epidermal junction. A bottom row has three smaller panels: IgG (dark fluorescence image with a green line along the basement membrane zone and an open arrow), C3 (dark fluorescence image with a broader green band and an open arrow) and PAS (magenta stained section with an open arrow and a black arrow). No scale bars are printed.

panels.general_description: Hematoxylin and eosin stained skin section filling the large top panel, labeled HE, with a hash symbol, an asterisk, two arrowheads and two arrows.
panels.detailed_description: Large top panel labeled "HE" at lower left. A thick layer of pink wavy keratin lies at the top and is marked with a hash symbol. Below it the epidermis shows pale vacuolated cells; an asterisk marks an area of pale intercellular spacing at the left. Two black arrowheads point to cells at the lower epidermis, and two black arrows point to the junction zone between the epidermis and the dermis. The dermis below contains many scattered nuclei, small vessels and pale spaces.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Pink and purple stained tissue section with nuclei and keratin layer

evidence.quote: Histopathological examination revealed skin with mild epidermal hyperplasia and diffuse spongiosis, hyperkeratosis, mild acanthosis and vacuolar degeneration of the basal layer with few apoptotic cells.

HE – hematoxylin and eosin; IgG, C3 – direct immunofluorescence; PAS – periodic acid Schiff; 200 × .
